_schema: Machine-readable licence registry for this release. One entry per UPSTREAM source. This release does NOT apply a single blanket licence over source-derived material.

derived_artifact_license.covers: material authored by us: the normalized parquet layer's structure, the derivation/validation scripts, SCHEMA.md, the dataset card, the manifests, and the adjudication protocol/rubric.
derived_artifact_license.does_not_cover: upstream benchmark content, and model-generated text (see below).

upstream_sources.what_is_redistributed_here: problem_uid identifiers, AND incidental verbatim problem text quoted inside agent/prompt transcripts (measured, see redistribution_measurement).
upstream_sources.redistribution_measurement: The parquet layer ships no problem_text column and no gold-answer column. However role_messages.text contains agent turns that quote the problem, so upstream problem text IS incidentally redistributed: a 60-character problem prefix appears verbatim for 16 of 606 checked problems (2.6%) in role_messages, and 0 of 606 in evaluator_calls. In the raw FROZEN traces the full prompts are present, so upstream problem text is redistributed there at a much higher rate. GOLD ANSWERS: no gold/reference field exists in any released row (checked across all released trace rows and every parquet column).
upstream_sources.obligation: Apache-2.0 permits redistribution of the source text and of derivatives, with attribution and licence notice preserved. Attribution is given in LICENSES/README.md, README.md and VERSION. Because Apache-2.0 is permissive about redistributing the text itself, the incidental quoting above is permitted — but it is stated rather than denied, because the earlier claim 'only problem_uid is redistributed' was not accurate for the trace layer.
upstream_sources.verification: Upstream HF API license tag 'license:apache-2.0' and cardData.license 'apache-2.0', fetched anonymously 2026-09-30; cross-checked against registry/licenses.parquet and registry/benchmarks.parquet in the SciAgentTrace release registry, which agree.

upstream_sources.what_is_redistributed_here: nothing — no SciBench row is present in v1.0.0
upstream_sources.obligation: If the reserved second-domain slot is filled (see config/SECOND_DOMAIN_SLOT.md), the upstream MIT notice and citation must be preserved and a SciBench entry added here. MIT is NOT the same licence as this release's Apache-2.0 material and must not be absorbed into it.
Preserve the upstream MIT notice and citation if ever included.

CARRIES AN UPSTREAM DO-NOT-TRAIN CANARY. If LAB-Bench material is ever added, the canary string must be preserved verbatim, the do-not-train request honoured and restated in the card, and ShareAlike applied to redistributed source content. ShareAlike is INCOMPATIBLE with silently relicensing that content under this release's Apache-2.0.
upstream_sources.verification: Upstream HF API license tag 'license:cc-by-sa-4.0' and cardData.license 'cc-by-sa-4.0', fetched anonymously 2026-09-30; agrees with registry/licenses.parquet.

upstream_sources.obligation: NonCommercial AND ShareAlike. Adding MaScQA content would make that content non-commercial-only, which this release's Apache-2.0 statement cannot cover.

model_generated_text.note: Trajectory text is generated by google/gemma-4-31B-it, openai/gpt-oss-120b and meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct. The respective model providers' terms govern the generated text; it is not covered by the Apache-2.0 statement above.

do_not_train.this_release: No do-not-train canary applies to v1.0.0, because no LAB-Bench material is included. The Omni-MATH-2 upstream is marked evaluation_only_recommended: we recommend evaluation use rather than training on these trajectories.
do_not_train.if_labbench_added: the upstream canary must be preserved and the request honoured.
